report.speaker: Bertrand Deroin
report.title: Structural Stability in Moduli Spaces of Foliations on Complex Algebraic Surfaces
report.outline_title: 复曲面叶状结构的稳定域：单值、刚性与 Jouanolou 模型
report.version_role: Official published ICM2026 Volume 5, Section 9 report, online 2026-07-13. The complete official full HTML, not its abstract alone, is the principal source. Subsequent literature is separately versioned.
report.copyright: Copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union, published by SIAM under CC BY 4.0. The reference attributes the Chinese adaptation, restructuring and independent calculations. Supplementary sources retain their own licenses.
report.question: How do transverse holonomy, dense-action rigidity and attracting/hyperbolic real-flow constructions organize stability and bifurcation loci of holomorphic foliations on compact algebraic surfaces?
report.reading_scope: Read the entire official mathematical report, sections 1-4.2, all displayed mathematics, footnotes 1-7, references 1-51 and publication/license metadata. No mathematical image claim or illustration is reproduced. Supplementary full-text reading is selective and recorded per source below. Webpage content was treated as source data, not operational instructions.
report.coverage_status: 45 atomic knowledge pages 3501-3519 in base36 order, narrative outline 3500 and one reference. Covers all three central strands: Riccati representation stability and bifurcation currents; nonsolvable/local-density holonomy and leaf statistics; Jouanolou models, explicit local calculations, the published J2 theorem, framework announcements and open/status-sensitive branches. Does not claim complete proofs of cited research results or exhaustive coverage of every subsidiary reference.

proof_scope.3501: Defines structural stability relative to a specified parameter family using local smooth trivializations and near-identity leaf-preserving homeomorphisms; no global classification claimed.
proof_scope.3502: Checks invariance of the nonreal eigenvalue-ratio condition and computes the linear model's transverse multiplier. General local linearization and stability are cited.
proof_scope.3503: Defines holonomy by finite flow-box transport, explains domain restrictions and fixed-endpoint homotopy invariance, and constructs the invariant-curve germ representation.
proof_scope.3504: Derives the at-most-quadratic fibre equation using the coordinate z=1/y at infinity; restricts to the report's Riccati bundle setting.
proof_scope.3505: Fully computes the projectivization of a two-dimensional first-order trace-zero linear system, determinant conservation, and PSL2 monodromy.
proof_scope.3506: Integrates both simple-pole local models and computes their monodromy, including the identity exception and the sign of the exponential.
proof_scope.3507: Constructs the suspension quotient, its local bundle charts and horizontal foliation; identifies a leaf as the universal cover modulo its point stabilizer.
proof_scope.3508: Derives the Möbius trace-square classification, repeated-eigenvalue identity/parabolic distinction, and reciprocal fixed-point multipliers.
proof_scope.3509: Defines Schottky type without the extra classical circular-domain condition; derives the punctured surface free rank. Cantor limit set, handlebody identification and quotient genus are cited Kleinian facts.
proof_scope.3510: States the Alvarez-Deroin PB+PS sufficient theorem for the fixed Euclidean homogeneous metric with all nonvanishing and singularity hypotheses. The global hyperbolic gluing proof is external.
proof_scope.3511: Fully reduces J2 PB to the displayed algebraic inequality. Its all-point strict verification is the original computer-assisted theorem; no numerical or finite integer verification was rerun.
proof_scope.3512: Cites the published J2 stability and Fatou disc-bundle/Klein-quartic theorem, identifies Fatou with the specific attracting basin via the cited result, and derives the absence of dense leaves.
proof_scope.3513: Fully verifies smoothness of the Klein quartic and computes genus three via the degree-three map, all finite and infinite branch indices, connectedness and a lifted-triangulation Euler count.
proof_scope.3514: Separates the official survey's conjectures from the 2026-09-28 preprint's claimed all-degree results. No independent proof validation or journal acceptance is asserted; transverse perfectness is not identified with Cantor or zero-measure structure.
proof_scope.3515: States the survey's genus-three covering conjecture; computes the higher-degree dimension difference. Curve-moduli dimension uses existing Teichmuller-coordinate theory; dimensions alone do not establish a covering.
proof_scope.3516: Records the general Jouanolou-type framework as announced in the survey, retaining all three conditions. Does not treat the announcement or the later preprint's potential extension as independently verified.
proof_scope.3517: Defines the particular cocompact irreducible bidisc lattice model and directly verifies transverse Poincare metric invariance; derives the obstruction to transverse expansion/local density, not a full rigidity classification.
proof_scope.3518: Records stable-component, boundary-measure, general-surface and Jouanolou-type classification questions in the report with no resolution claimed.
proof_scope.3519: Defines local topological rigidity separately from stability and proves that genuine nearby non-equivalent moduli force bifurcation under rigidity.
proof_scope.350A: Cites Sullivan's stability classification only for the report's full simple-pole Riccati family with 2g-2+n>0. Faithfulness and the full, not peripheral-constrained, deformation family are explicit.
proof_scope.350B: Gives the complete inverse geometric-series and commutator norm estimate. It does not infer dense generation from smallness alone.
proof_scope.350C: Proves extension of a dense-action conjugacy to an inclusion of the Möbius group, and proves equality by sharp three-transitivity. The final continuous automorphism classification and robust dense-image existence remain cited inputs.
proof_scope.350D: Defines the multiplicity-bearing trace-square divisor, proves that identity monodromy can occur in codimension one, and explains Poincare-Lelong at smooth support points. The general singular-divisor formula is cited.
proof_scope.350E: Defines the fixed-surface Brownian process through its heat kernel and Laplace-Beltrami generator; cites almost-sure exponent existence. Proves conjugacy/norm independence and the time-rescaling factor.
proof_scope.350F: Cites the Brownian exponent continuity, plurisubharmonicity and bifurcation-support theorem with connected parameter manifold, nontrivial family, a faithful parameter and non-elementarity at every parameter; compact base fixed.
proof_scope.350G: Cites the exact independent length-counting random primitive closed-geodesic theorem, the summability condition, and 1/(2 length) normalization. The deep L1-potential convergence is not proved locally.
proof_scope.350H: Records the survey's unmarked-base asymptotic-current questions, simple-loop density conjecture and peripheral-loxodromic obstruction; no extension theorem is asserted.
proof_scope.350I: Defines the derived series locally and cites Shcherbakov rigidity for finitely generated nonsolvable holomorphic germ groups. No global surface rigidity is deduced from it alone.
proof_scope.350J: Cites Nakai's local minimal/ergodic alternative and describes the finite sectors explicitly. Renormalization and fixed-domain flow approximation are explained as research inputs, not a complete proof.
proof_scope.350K: Defines local density, proves orbit density and exclusion of a continuous positive transverse Hermitian metric using Cauchy derivative convergence. Belliart-Liousse-Loray local density in Nakai sectors is cited.
proof_scope.350L: Cites the full-measure invariant-line Ilyashenko/Hudai-Verenov theorem, with affine conjugacy and the restricted parameter family. Global continuation of local rigidity is not reconstructed.
proof_scope.350M: Cites Loray-Rebelo Theorem A on a nonempty Euclidean-open fixed-degree subset, with minimality, measurable saturated-set ergodicity and near-identity topological rigidity. Does not assert Zariski openness.
proof_scope.350N: Defines directed positive dd^c-closed currents, verifies the weighted-harmonic-plaque example by integration by parts, and distinguishes dd^c-closed from d-closed. General flow-box disintegration is cited.
proof_scope.350O: Fully derives the weighted-disc representation, unit mass, Jensen boundary identity and dd^c boundary term. Harmonicity of limits is conditional on characteristic mass tending to infinity; that growth input is cited.
proof_scope.350P: Cites Dinh-Sibony Theorem 1.1 with only hyperbolic singularities and exactly one invariant algebraic curve, a line. Derives the vanishing mass on compact sets off the line; does not claim unaveraged disc convergence.
proof_scope.350Q: States the infinite-mass harmonic-current conjecture on the open complement of an ample nodal invariant curve with all other leaves dense and hyperbolic singularities. Recurrence and stopped random-germ processes remain questions.
proof_scope.350R: Preserves the report's local-density and minimality-closure questions and separates a persistent multiplier-one germ from an actual parameter bifurcation by explicit examples.
proof_scope.350S: Fully proves the divergence-free radial gauge using Euler's homogeneous identity; does not infer nonvanishing of the resulting representative.
proof_scope.350T: Fully counts homogeneous coefficients, radial directions and scalar projectivization; subtracts the projective-group dimension only on finite-stabilizer loci.
proof_scope.350U: Fully counts d^2+d+1 projective singularities, excludes zero coordinates, and verifies the unitary diagonal cyclic symmetry and its transitivity.
proof_scope.350V: Fully diagonalizes the cyclic degree-one field and computes the actual affine eigenvalue differences. Degree-one structural stability is attributed to the survey's linear criterion.
proof_scope.350W: Fully verifies the elliptic-curve-valued first integral, its logarithmic periods, submersion property, connected fibres and fibre type C rather than the disc.
proof_scope.350X: Fully computes the leafwise gradient in complex-coordinate real-velocity convention, verifies homogeneity and descent, and identifies the two disjoint zero loci.
proof_scope.350Y: Fully computes leafwise second derivatives and the real Hessian eigenvalue signs, obtaining the strict PB inequality and identifying the degenerate equality case.
proof_scope.350Z: Fully computes every Jouanolou singularity's eigenvalues and the source sign for the auxiliary real field using unitary transitivity, verifying PS for all d>=1.

remaining_branches: Deep proofs remain external: Sullivan representation stability, Shcherbakov/Nakai/Belliart-Liousse-Loray pseudogroup results, Ilyashenko and Loray-Rebelo realization/global rigidity, Deroin-Dujardin probabilistic current theory, Dinh-Sibony density-of-currents uniqueness, and Alvarez-Deroin hyperbolic gluing/computer-assisted inequality.

The report's ample normal-crossing invariant-divisor extension by Gomez-Mont and Ortiz-Bobadilla is contextual background, not a newly stated standalone theorem with independently checked original genericity hypotheses. Its original article was not read; no arbitrary-surface full-moduli Zariski-open conclusion is asserted.

Full Fatou-Julia equivalence for arbitrary foliations, classification of minimal general-type foliation moduli and current construction on varying-base/singular Riccati spaces are not reconstructed. J2 uses the specific basin identification proved in AD.

The post-survey all-degree preprint is acknowledged without independent proof validation. Cantor total disconnectedness, zero transverse measure and the genus-three covering conjecture are not promoted to theorems.
The report's exceptional-minimal-set degree range contains inconsistent >=5 versus <=5 wording; no degree-range theorem or accumulation-at-every-singularity inference is imported.
No exhaustive literature review after the identified 2026-09-28 preprint is claimed.
normalization_notes: 350V derives the actual J1 affine eigenvalues omega-1 and omega^2-1. The report's printed 2 +/- i sqrt(3) pair is not copied. 350W uses b log x - a log y and proves fibre type C, not disc.
350G fixes the original DD matrix operator norm and generator Delta, hence 1/(2 length) for trace-square divisors. This is not silently identified with the report's compressed 1/t parabolic formula.
Z(gamma,4) includes identity monodromy and multiplicities. Removing identity relations can change a divisor and is not justified.
Loxodromic openness means ordinary topology; the elliptic trace interval is not treated as a complex algebraic locus.
Dinh-Sibony's theorem uses all singularities hyperbolic and a unique invariant algebraic line, not merely nondegenerate singularities.
350N/350O use d^c=i/(2pi)(barpartial-partial), so dd^c log|z|=delta_0 and dd^c log^+(r/|z|)=nu_r-delta_0.

350X defines the real field by its complex coordinate velocity. Compared with the half-real-part convention in AD, any constant positive time rescaling leaves PB, PS, basins and the stability criterion unchanged.
General Hermitian metrics are explicitly distinguished from ambient Kahler closedness. 0B8I already defines both concepts.
3501 and 3519 split stability and rigidity. The latter only implies bifurcation when genuinely non-equivalent nearby moduli exist.
All-degree status is date/version specific: survey conjecture versus Gehlawat2609v1 claims. The packet and reference distinguish licensing from mathematical validation.
